BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to "Music Matters" special license plates; amendingRCW 46.18.200, 46.17.220, and 46.68.420; and adding a new section tochapter 46.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.18.200 and 2010 c 161 s 611 are each amended toread as follows:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Music Matters license plates" means special license plates issuedunder RCW 46.18.200 that display the "Music Matters" logo.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.68.420 and 2010 c 161 s 809 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText:
(1) The department shall: (a) Collect special license plate fees established under RCW46.17.220 ((that were approved by the special license plate reviewboard under RCW 46.18.200)); (b) Deduct an amount not to exceed twelve dollars for initial issueand two dollars for renewal issue for administration and collectionexpenses incurred by it; and (c) Remit the remaining proceeds to the custody of the statetreasurer with a proper identifying detailed report.
